label: Occurrence frame for the target mental…: Frame has occurrences that instantiate kinds
term: occurrence frame for the target mental kind
definition: Frame has occurrences that instantiate kinds. Physical e means e has some physical kind; Mental e means e has the designated target kind, which may or may not itself be physical. An occurrence may have several kinds. Causes is a primitive relation with no assumed transitivity, asymmetry or well-foundedness; ordinary example: a decision causing an arm movement; counterexample: a mere correlate of that movement. A frame fixes the strict or generous reading of causes. See docs/notes/mind-physicalism-fork-419.md for grounding and rivals.
note: Analyst vocabulary following Papineau's facts-as-relata choice (pp.9-10). Reading of causal relata as particulars, which he also discusses, would need another frame.
